correctness.rationale: For every n>=4 and 0<p<1, centered-edge orthogonal decomposition reduces the exact mixed moment to support sizes 2,3,4. Coefficient identities are rational-polynomial certified at 13 distinct p values per support, with degree<=12; independent exhaustive G(n,p) enumeration for n=4,5,6 at p=1/3,1/2,2/3 confirms the formula. Explicit 1/n expansions and variance projection types give two simple sign roots and correlation profile; compact convergence and implicit function theorem establish local root completeness. Limits and finite checks are clearly differentiated.

value.rationale: The induced four-vertex claw and path are canonical network graphlets with direct statistical motivation from the 2014 graphlet modeling literature. A nontrivial cancellation in leading n^5 mixed covariance produces an n^4 mixed effect, three competing Fourier supports, and two asymmetric 1/n-scale sign crossings with explicit constants. This is a structurally motivated second-order dependence result rather than routine recalculation of a known graphlet table.
